payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. PathMNIST (9-class, 28×28 RGB, standard MedMNIST distribution) loaded with exact official split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), no subsampling, archive MD5 verified. Data profile is thorough: modest class imbalance (ratio 1.63), no blank images, no duplicates, train/val class proportions closely aligned (max deviation <0.001), and channel statistics in expected [0,1] range. Ambiguity risks for visually similar histology classes at 28×28 resolution are well-identified and realistic. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is a known dataset property relevant to OOD evaluation, not a defect. Two minor LLM-flagged items are non-blocking: (1) worker image_digest is null, expected at this stage but should be populated before training for full reproducibility; (2) isolation.enforced=false with local_subprocess execution, acceptable but noted for audit trail. No deterministic findings. Compacted-field previews (ambiguity_note, anomaly_ingestion.comment) are preview truncations only, not incomplete artefacts. Proceed to next stage.
llm_issues: worker image_digest is null; verify it is populated before training begins for full reproducibility audit trail
